persistence.alarm: at least two of the current and previous two raw aggregate statistics strictly exceed the aggregator threshold
persistence.continuous_statistic_for_roc: second-largest raw aggregate statistic in the causal three-window history
persistence.warmup: first two scoreable windows of every contiguous support run are non-alarm and excluded from ROC/pAUC denominators

required_before_any_payload_stat_hash_op: clean feature scaler and threshold fit complete
clean holdout and synthetic dilution results committed
local and remote freeze SHA equal with ahead/behind 0/0
fresh clean checkout of the pushed freeze SHA

bootstrap.unit: non-overlapping contiguous 10-second blocks; never individual windows

clean_split.rule: 1-second windows are assigned by causal raw-time window end; no overlapping or adjacent samples cross a C-1 split boundary

feature_contract.epoch_transform: for complex taps c[-4..4] and prompt p=c[0], y_j=c_j*conj(p)/max(|p|^2,1e-12); this removes prompt phase and amplitude
features_per_prn_window: componentwise median real and imaginary parts of the nine normalized complex taps
componentwise MAD of the real and imaginary nine-tap residual about the window median
real and imaginary early/late antisymmetry for four mirrored tap pairs
real and imaginary center-relative second differences at the seven interior taps
feature_contract.finite_support: valid tracking and lock TRACE rows with finite complex taps and nonzero prompt only; C/N0 and lock are exclusion/audit fields, never score features
feature_contract.global_scaler: one feature-wise median and 1.4826*MAD fit on clean-development rows, shared across all PRNs; scale floor 1e-6

format_contract.decoder: big-endian signed int16 interleaved I,Q -> native little-endian float32 complex, I/Q unchanged, scale 1.0

hypothesis: When k of M PRNs are spoofed, a cross-PRN mean dilutes their local morphology anomaly approximately by k/M, while a clean-standardized multi-quantile set statistic can reduce this dilution without knowing k.

metrics.pauc_definition: trapezoidal ROC area from FPR 0 to 0.01 with linear boundary interpolation, divided by 0.01

receiver_contract.engineering_extension: apply the byte-bound R2c terminal-drain/native-TRACE patch, then change only its native-TRACE eligibility guard to allow Galileo signal 1B with track_pilot=true; correlator, acquisition, tracking loops, tap positions, and record layout remain unchanged

aggregation: SS-1 and SS-3 MULTI_Q detection rate minus MEAN is at least 0.15 in each
SS-1 and SS-3 MULTI_Q normalized pAUC@0.01 minus MEAN is at least 0.10 in each
mean MULTI_Q pAUC across SS-1 and SS-3 is greater than mean MAX pAUC
SS-5 MULTI_Q detection rate is no more than 0.05 below MEAN
no serious reversal: MULTI_Q detection rate at k=3 or k=5 is not more than 0.10 below its lower-k predecessor
MULTI_Q-minus-MEAN detection-rate bootstrap 95% lower bound exceeds zero in at least two partial scenarios
false_alarm: multipath-clean FPR <=0.02 if such a clean scenario exists
local_signal: per-PRN spoof-vs-genuine AUC >=0.75 in at least two partial scenarios
technical: each scoreable event window has >=5 actual tracked PRNs
at least one spoofed PRN is stably tracked in every primary partial scenario

threshold_contract.method: block-calibrated empirical threshold; for each aggregator choose the smallest observed calibration statistic whose causal persistent calibration FPR is <=0.01, using the maximum observed statistic if no lower attainable threshold qualifies

window_contract.support: actual dynamically tracked PRNs only; no fixed 10-slot panel; minimum 5 PRNs per event window
